item.title: Bilton Truth: The Good News of Wes Huff
item.description: There seems to have been a recent explosion of interest in the evidence for the Christian faith - especially with the younger generations. And Canadian Wes Huff has been on the front lines of sharing this evidence. I believe there is much to celebrate about this and the hunger for Truth around the world, as well as some things we can learn from Wes about how he shares the Truth lovingly and without compromise.

item.title: Breaking News - Alfred Ngaro joins NZ First
item.description: Former National Cabinet minister and leader of the NewZeal party at the last election Alfred Ngaro has announced that he's standing as a candidate for NZ First at the November General Election. Bob and Simon discuss the implications of the decision for NZ First, Christian parties in general, whether we will see more National MPs (both current and ex) go to NZ First, and how will the media cover this issue.

item.title: Daybreak - 23 March 2026 - Exclusive Interview
item.description: In this episode of Daybreak - an exclusive interview with new NZ First candidate Alfred Ngaro. The former National Cabinet minister and leader of the NewZeal party at the last election has announced that he's standing as a candidate for NZ First at the November General Election. We also take some of your questions.

item.title: StraightTalk - 23 March 2026
item.description: In this episode we discuss: the latest political poll showing a completely divided country; former National cabinet minister and NewZeal leader and former founding panelist on StraightTalk Alfred Ngaro joins Winston Peters and is standing for NZ First at the upcoming election; in light of the coverage of Chris Hipkin’s family issues, should the private lives of politicians ever be public – and if so, when; we also discuss how the media handled this issue.

item.title: Solid Ground - 24 March 2026
item.description: In this episode, Simon explains his anger on the prior night’s Straight Talk panel (with Christine Rankin, Mel Taylor, and Rodney Hyde) about media treatment of allegations and its impact on families.

item.title: Family Matters - Erica Komisar: Choosing your kids over childcare
item.description: In this episode of Family Matters, Simon interviews Erica Komisar - a clinical social worker, psychoanalyst, author, coach to parents, a mother, New Yorker and much sought after commentator across television, radio, and international conferences. Erica stresses the vital importance of a child’s attachment to its parents, arguing that parents should do everything they can to be the ones raising their child – not early childcare, not the government, or others.
